channel.title: Junior Baking Show
channel.desc: It's Bread Day, and the first heat of junior bakers has a lot of dough to prove; for the Technical, judges Liam Charles and Ravneet Gill task the bakers with creating cinnamon snails, then, for the Showstopper, the young bakers must bake a loaf inspired by their ultimate desert-island meal; who can prove themselves worthy of Star Baker, and who'll be left high and dry?
